Subject: Evening compliance sprint — SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough availability

Hi Anita —

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. FinServe's timeline makes total sense and we want to make the walkthrough as low-friction as possible for your ops team. A couple notes up front: we typically run the intake as a focused sprint (60–90 minutes depending on scope) covering SOC 2 control mapping, DPA questions, and a short pen-test orientation.

Because your regional ops team prefers after-hours availability, can you confirm whether one of the following CEST slots would work for a 60-minute sprint (we can extend to 90 if you prefer):

- Tue, 26 May — 18:00–19:00 CEST
- Wed, 27 May — 19:00–20:00 CEST

I've attached a short evidence checklist and a draft agenda to help the call run fast. If you need us to include network/infra contacts or an external pen vendor on the bridge, flag those folks and we will add them to the invite.

Would you prefer 60 or 90 minutes? Once you confirm a slot I will send a calendar invite with the Zoom bridge and an internal ops cover (Kim will be on-call).

Best,

Logan Wright
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks — both slots look possible but our security lead (Marcus) prefers the 90-minute window so we can cover the DPA specifics and the pen-test scoping. Wed 27 May 19:00–20:30 CEST would be ideal for us.
